what_this_is_a_property_of: Kernel 6.17.0-1020-azure on x86_64, measured at euid 0. That release string names an Azure hypervisor guest, which is what GitHub's hosted runners are, so this is a figure from a virtualized kernel and not from a bare Linux host. Syscall-interception overhead is the measurement most sensitive to that difference and it may not transfer. Two records taken on different kernels are not a before and an after and must not be subtracted.
A CPython supervisor doing one ioctl and one /proc/<pid>/mem read per notification. A Go or C supervisor would be faster by an unmeasured amount.
